cards.headline: Witkoff meets Zelenskyy in Oslo before travelling to Russia
cards.summary: Trump envoy Steve Witkoff met Zelenskyy to try to restart peace talks and is expected to travel on to Russia, where the FT says he will ask for release of a US hostage. Zelenskyy says intelligence on missile strikes works now.
cards.why_it_matters: The talks could shape whether the war continues and how US-Ukraine relations, strained over intelligence and sanctions, develop.

sources.title: Witkoff meets Zelenskyy before travelling to Russia
Ukraine thankful that intelligence on missile strikes ‘works now’, says Zelenskyy – Europe live

cards.headline: Republicans push back on Trump's Russia stance as Rubio calls Zelenskyy
cards.summary: A handful of Republicans criticized Trump's softer line on Russia after the diesel deal and sanctions pause. Rubio told Zelenskyy Trump gave no order to harm Ukraine, Axios reports. Vance called Ukraine a partner with some divergent interests.
cards.why_it_matters: Intra-party resistance could limit the White House's room on Russia sanctions and Ukraine aid ahead of the midterms.

sources.title: Republicans push back on Donald Trump’s wavering support for Ukraine
Trump isn't out to hurt Ukraine, Rubio tells Zelensky
Vance says Ukraine is a 'partner' but has some 'divergent interests' from US

cards.headline: Alberta voters overwhelmingly reject path toward leaving Canada
cards.summary: Voters in Alberta decisively backed staying in Canada in a referendum. Prime Minister Mark Carney called it a great result. Separatist leaders vow to continue, though the margin may make that difficult. The Canadian dollar hit a near one-month high.
cards.why_it_matters: Canada is the largest US trade partner and an energy supplier, so national unity affects North American markets and stability.

sources.title: 'Great result for Canada', says Carney as Alberta votes to reject separatism
Alberta voters overwhelmingly reject plan to leave Canada in referendum
Canadian Dollar Hits Nearly One-Month High After Alberta Vote

cards.headline: Sudan army drones reportedly kill more than 300 at funeral and market
cards.summary: Sources told the BBC that drones from the Sudanese army hit a truck carrying people to a funeral and a market alleged to supply fuel to the RSF, killing more than 300. Casualty figures come from sources and are not independently confirmed.
cards.why_it_matters: The strikes point to a deepening humanitarian crisis in one of the world's worst conflicts, with civilians bearing the toll.

sources.title: Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say

cards.headline: Kenya confirms ninth Ebola case amid regional spread concerns
cards.summary: A 24-year-old man already held in quarantine tested positive, bringing Kenya's confirmed Ebola cases to nine as the regional outbreak widens.
cards.why_it_matters: Spread of Ebola raises global health risk and tests international response capacity, including US-funded efforts.

sources.title: Kenya confirms ninth Ebola case amid concerns about regional spread

cards.headline: France calls platforms to emergency meetings over protest footage
cards.summary: The French government told TikTok and other sites to curb protest footage and AI-altered images, Wired reports. Retailers such as Vinted and eBay reportedly agreed to keep looted goods off resale sites. PM Lecornu told parliament far-left groups forged an insurrectionary plan.
cards.why_it_matters: The response tests how democracies police online content during unrest, and French instability affects markets and US companies.

sources.title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
French PM says far-left groups forged ‘insurrectionary plan’ against government

cards.headline: Macron lines up more Gulf diesel as French fuel prices soar
cards.summary: During a Gulf trip, Macron secured UAE and Bahrain deals lifting French diesel commitments to 295,000 tonnes a month, just over 10 percent of consumption. Opponents Le Pen and Melenchon criticized him for leaving during the riots, Fox News reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The fuel scramble shows how the Iran war ripples through allies' economies and competes with US efforts to source supply.

sources.title: Macron lines up more Gulf diesel as France battles soaring fuel prices
Macron jets out of riot-torn France for Gulf trip as political pressure mounts

cards.headline: UK to deploy Typhoon jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthis
cards.summary: RAF Typhoons will fly defensive missions over Saudi cities and critical infrastructure, extending UK support for Riyadh after Houthi strikes on the kingdom.
cards.why_it_matters: Wider Western involvement in Gulf defense raises the stakes for energy supply and for US forces in the region.

sources.title: UK to deploy fighter jets to protect Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks

cards.headline: Turkiye moves to ratify Mecca defence pact with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan
cards.summary: Turkiye is moving to ratify a trilateral Mecca agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan laying out provisions for joint defence.
cards.why_it_matters: A new regional defense bloc could reshape Gulf security calculations as the Iran war and Houthi attacks continue.

sources.title: Turkiye moves to ratify Mecca defence pact with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia

cards.headline: Two men rearrested over RAF Fairford incident; police link it to Iran
cards.summary: UK police rearrested two men on suspicion of breaching the National Security Act, and for the first time linked the RAF Fairford incident to Iran, the FT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: RAF Fairford hosts US aircraft, so any Iran-linked threat on UK soil bears on US forces and allies.

sources.title: Police rearrest two men over RAF Fairford incident

cards.headline: Pending US home sales fall to record low as mortgage rates surge
cards.summary: Sales contracts dropped 7.3% in September as rising borrowing costs deepened the housing slowdown, the FT reports. Builders are cutting prices as buyer traffic hits a 14-year low.
cards.why_it_matters: High mortgage rates are pricing out buyers and hitting a major economic sector.

sources.title: US pending home sales fall to record low as mortgage rates surge
Builders slash prices on new homes as buyer traffic drops to 14-year low
Homebuilder sentiment is at a 14-year low

cards.headline: US budget deficit reaches $2 trillion as debt costs rise
cards.summary: Axios reports the federal deficit is on track to reach $2 trillion this fiscal year, citing the latest figures, as interest costs on the debt climb.
cards.why_it_matters: Larger deficits and higher interest costs compete with other spending and can keep long-term borrowing rates high.

sources.title: The budget deficit swells, while the cost of debt rises

cards.headline: GM trims profit outlook despite new $20 billion buyback plan
cards.summary: General Motors shares fell after it narrowed 2026 adjusted EBIT guidance to $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion from $14 billion to $16 billion. CEO Mary Barra warned of intensifying challenges.
cards.why_it_matters: A cautious outlook from the largest US automaker signals pressure on car prices, jobs and auto-sector earnings.

sources.title: GM Slides as CEO Barra Warns of ‘Intensifying’ Challenges

cards.headline: Salesforce to buy Braze for $5.66 billion; its own stock falls
cards.summary: Salesforce will pay $47.50 per share in cash for Braze, sending Braze up about 50%. Salesforce shares fell as investors questioned the high premium.
cards.why_it_matters: The deal shows continued enterprise software consolidation around AI-driven marketing tools.

sources.title: Salesforce announces $5.66 billion deal for Braze, sending BRZE stock soaring 50%
Salesforce’s stock falls as investors chafe at the cost of latest AI purchase

cards.headline: Seoul data centre builder Elice tumbles 32% on trading debut
cards.summary: Shares in South Korean data centre builder Elice sank on their first day of trading, adding to concern about AI valuations, the FT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Weak AI-related listings feed worries that spread to US tech stocks and retirement portfolios.

sources.title: South Korean data centre builder tumbles 32% on trading debut
AI rally fades away from Wall Street as a tiny IPO makes big waves

cards.headline: China defends DeepSeek and warns of retaliation after US ban
cards.summary: China pushed back on the DHS order removing DeepSeek products from federal civilian systems, warning of possible retaliation. The order, dated July, was published in the Federal Register Monday and cites national security concerns.
cards.why_it_matters: The dispute widens US-China tension over AI technology and could invite countermeasures against American firms.

sources.title: China defends DeepSeek after US ban
US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems

cards.headline: HSBC CEO warns not every AI data center will be a good bet
cards.summary: HSBC's chief executive cautioned that the AI boom will not make every data center a sound investment, as financing for the buildout draws scrutiny.
cards.why_it_matters: Bank caution on data center lending bears on the AI buildout and on credit markets.

sources.title: HSBC CEO warns the AI boom won’t make every data center a good bet

cards.headline: Meta pauses Muse chat sharing after reports it exposes secrets
cards.summary: Ars Technica reports Meta's Muse exposed users' personal and business information when they shared conversations, and Meta is suspending the feature. TechCrunch separately reports Muse passed 10 million US downloads in 40 days.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a privacy warning for people using AI assistants with sensitive information.

sources.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps

cards.headline: TikTok staff raised child safety concerns, court records show
cards.summary: Court documents obtained by NPR show TikTok employees were frustrated that executives did not act on warnings about risks to children, including minors bypassing safeguards.
cards.why_it_matters: The records may bolster lawsuits and regulation affecting an app used by tens of millions of American teens.

sources.title: TikTok staff raised child safety concerns, but executives reportedly failed to act
TikTok employees said they knew about child safety issues, but execs failed to act

cards.headline: Google cloud outage hits UK banks and websites
cards.summary: A power outage at a Google datacentre in London disrupted banking services, including Revolut, and put court hearings on hold. Google says services are recovering.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how reliance on a few cloud providers can disrupt finance and public services, including for US firms.

sources.title: Google says services recovering after cloud outage hits UK banks and websites
Power outage at Google datacentre in London causes widespread disruption

cards.headline: Reliable Robotics and Eka Robotics top $1 billion valuations
cards.summary: Autonomous aviation startup Reliable Robotics added $115 million in equity and $25 million in debt. Eka Robotics is valued at $1.45 billion for a robotic arm model that experts say picks varied objects well.
cards.why_it_matters: Investor money is flowing into physical AI even as concerns about AI financing grow.

sources.title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation
Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving

cards.headline: Navy lifts Gecko Robotics contract to $300 million
cards.summary: The US Navy expanded its AI maintenance contract with Gecko Robotics to $300 million. The company uses drones, wall-climbing robots and fixed sensors to inspect hulls, decks and welds.
cards.why_it_matters: Faster ship maintenance matters for naval readiness as shipbuilding competition with China grows.

sources.title: US Navy, Gecko Robotics surge AI maintenance contract to $300M
Gecko Robotics secures $300M contract with the U.S. Navy

cards.headline: F-22 pilot controls unmanned FQ-44 drone in flight
cards.summary: An Air Force F-22 pilot acted as an airborne quarterback, giving high-level directives to an Anduril-made Collaborative Combat Aircraft.
cards.why_it_matters: Crewed-uncrewed teaming is central to how the US plans to fight future air wars.

sources.title: US Air Force F-22 pilot controls unmanned FQ-44 in flight

cards.headline: China built more than twice the naval tonnage of US in 2024-25
cards.summary: A report presented at Euronaval says China built more than twice the naval tonnage of the US in 2024-25, narrowing the gap between the two navies.
cards.why_it_matters: Shipbuilding capacity affects US ability to deter China in the Pacific and protect trade routes.

sources.title: China built more than twice naval tonnage of US in 2024-25: Euronaval

cards.headline: Army unit earmarked to support Golden Dome missile shield
cards.summary: An Army official confirmed a US Army air defense unit has been earmarked to support the Golden Dome for America project.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how the multibillion-dollar homeland missile defense plan is taking operational shape.

sources.title: US Army support for Golden Dome missile shield takes shape

cards.headline: Trump and Vance announce $25 million fraud whistleblower program
cards.summary: The White House unveiled a Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program offering up to $30,000 for tips that lead to convictions, aimed at encouraging quick reporting of fraud to the federal government.
cards.why_it_matters: It adds a cash incentive for reporting fraud in federal programs, a theme in midterm campaigns.

sources.title: Trump puts fraudsters on notice with $25M whistleblower program offering cash for tips that deliver
WATCH LIVE: Trump and Vance announce $25 million fraud whistleblower program

cards.headline: RNC puts more than $50 million into final two weeks of midterms
cards.summary: The Republican National Committee is transferring over $50 million to groups defending the party's House and Senate majorities, the New York Times first reported.
cards.why_it_matters: The late spending signals where Republicans see their majorities at risk.

sources.title: RNC injects $50M into midterm races
Republicans see shrinking boost from redistricting

cards.headline: New Hampshire asks Supreme Court to reinstate student ID voting ban
cards.summary: State officials filed an emergency petition to lift a last-minute block on a law that bars student ID cards as valid voter identification, weeks before the midterms.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling would decide whether college students can use campus IDs to vote in a competitive election.

sources.title: New Hampshire urges Supreme Court to reinstate student ID voting ban ahead of election

cards.headline: Trump posts 'trash island' photos after East Potomac court hearing
cards.summary: Trump posted photos of crews removing trees from East Potomac Park, calling it 'Trash Island' for the judge to study. He plans to redevelop the site starting next month; a judge has pressed the administration on the plan.
cards.why_it_matters: The dispute tests limits on executive action over federal parkland and how courts review it.

sources.title: Trump posts photos of ‘trash island’ after intense court hearing over East Potomac renovation

cards.headline: DOJ and Education Dept. close 19 UNC probes after settlement
cards.summary: The Justice and Education departments closed 19 investigations into UNC Chapel Hill over alleged antisemitism and race-based discrimination as part of a settlement agreement with the university.
cards.why_it_matters: The deal is a template for how the administration resolves discrimination probes at public universities.
entities: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

sources.title: Trump administration closes 19 investigations into UNC over alleged discrimination after reaching deal

cards.headline: DOJ sends grand jury subpoenas to Philadelphia DA Krasner's office
cards.summary: Fox News cites sources saying grand jury subpoenas were sent to Larry Krasner's office after a federal judge referred him to the Justice Department for investigation.
cards.why_it_matters: A federal probe of a sitting big-city prosecutor raises questions about federal-local law enforcement relations.

sources.title: DOJ sends grand jury subpoenas to Philadelphia DA Krasner after judge's referral, sources say

cards.headline: Italy sends troops to Milan as France says military will deploy
cards.summary: Italy is sending 500 soldiers to Milan after cost-of-living protests turned into clashes and looting, promising a firm response. The Guardian says France also plans to deploy military forces.
cards.why_it_matters: Unrest in major European economies affects markets, tourism and allies' stability.

sources.title: Italy to deploy 500 troops to Milan after days of protests and looting
Italy sending hundreds of soldiers into Milan to quell days of violent riots

cards.headline: Man charged over alleged attack on Australian MP Helen Haines
cards.summary: Brendan Nugent, 43, faces three charges over the alleged attack in Wangaratta. Haines lost a leg and remains critical but stable. Nugent's family says they have been friends with her for more than 20 years.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on elected officials worry democracies, including the US, where political threats are rising.

sources.title: Brendan Nugent facing three charges over alleged attack on MP Helen Haines
Man charged with attack on Australian MP as suspect's father says she is family friend

cards.headline: Mukesh Ambani launches India's biggest IPO with Jio Platforms
cards.summary: Jio Platforms aims for about an 81 billion pound valuation when it floats Wednesday, in what could be India's largest-ever listing despite a stock market downturn.
cards.why_it_matters: A giant listing tests global appetite for emerging-market tech at a time of AI valuation worries.

sources.title: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani launches India’s biggest-ever IPO

cards.headline: Ryanair boss predicts record 20% air fare rise in 2027
cards.summary: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary said European fares could rise by as much as 20% next year as Middle East conflict pushes up jet fuel costs and many carriers are not hedged.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher fuel costs from the Iran war are feeding into travel prices, including for Americans flying to Europe.

sources.title: European air fares could rise by as much as 20% in 2027, Ryanair boss predicts

cards.headline: Energy crisis could become a food security crisis, report warns
cards.summary: A new report finds the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, combined with extreme weather, are creating a multidirectional squeeze on world agriculture that could drive up food prices.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher fuel and fertilizer costs can raise grocery prices and hit poorer countries hardest.

sources.title: How the energy crisis could become a food security crisis

cards.headline: US eyes India's Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil
cards.summary: The US is trying to persuade Reliance Industries to refine more Venezuelan crude as Washington seeks extra supply for a market rattled by the Iran conflict.
cards.why_it_matters: Finding new supply is one way the administration hopes to ease gasoline and diesel prices.

sources.title: US Eyes India’s Reliance to Refine Venezuelan Oil

cards.headline: Bipartisan lawmakers urge FDA to close peptide import loophole
cards.summary: A bipartisan group wants the FDA to stop imports of knockoff retatrutide, an investigational obesity drug from Eli Lilly, arriving through a regulatory loophole.
cards.why_it_matters: Unapproved copies of weight-loss drugs pose safety risks for Americans buying them online.

sources.title: STAT+: A bipartisan group of lawmakers urges the FDA to close a peptide loophole

cards.headline: Roche strikes China antibody-drug deal with Hansoh
cards.summary: China's Hansoh Pharmaceutical announced a large deal with Roche to develop a portfolio of antibody-drug conjugates, extending the Swiss drugmaker's search for new medicines in China.
cards.why_it_matters: Western drugmakers increasingly source experimental cancer drugs from China, shaping future US drug pipelines.

sources.title: STAT+: Roche continues to look to China for new drugs

cards.headline: Parasite-infected male mosquitoes released in Barcelona
cards.summary: Researchers released male mosquitoes infected with a parasite in Barcelona, a European first, aiming to reduce populations of insects that can transmit diseases such as dengue.
cards.why_it_matters: Mosquito-borne disease is spreading to new regions, so new control methods could matter for US states too.

sources.title: Parasite-infected mosquitoes released in Europe for first time

cards.headline: Uzbekistan becomes 77th signatory of the Artemis Accords
cards.summary: Uzbekistan signed the NASA-led Artemis Accords in Samarkand, committing to principles for safe, transparent and responsible civil space exploration.
cards.why_it_matters: A growing coalition backs the US-led framework for lunar activity, in competition with China's rival program.

sources.title: NASA Welcomes Uzbekistan as Newest Artemis Accords Signatory

cards.headline: Spotify removed 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from recommendations
cards.summary: Spotify says it removed over 50 million songs it considers AI-generated slop or spam from recommendations in the past year and changed its system to highlight more music by human artists.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how streaming services are responding to floods of AI content that affect what listeners hear and artists earn.

sources.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations

cards.headline: Trump official claims 300,000 visas were revoked
cards.summary: A spokesperson said the revocations targeted US visa holders who had allegedly broken the law, and described the total of 300,000 as a record. The figure is the administration's claim.
cards.why_it_matters: The scale of revocations affects international students, workers and visitors.

sources.title: Trump official claims record-breaking 300,000 visas were revoked
